name: site-header
title: Site Header
author: Justin Harris <justin@justinharris.ai>
description: The page header: brand, nav, one optional ask. Mobile disclosure is a native <details>, so it works with no runtime. Variants: simple, centered.
docs: Not @jhai/section-header, which is a heading block inside a band. This is the page's own header. The mobile menu is a <details> because the registry ships no runtime and a server component cannot hydrate one; the native element brings keyboard handling and the open/closed announcement with it.
